powers.name: Use

summary: On water, it becomes a swan-shaped boat 50 ft long that carries you for 24 hours.
text: A one-use token shaped like a feather. As a Magic action, touch it to a body of water at least 60 feet across and it becomes a boat shaped like a swan, 50 feet long and 20 feet wide, with room for up to 32 Medium or smaller creatures. The boat drives itself at 6 miles per hour, and while aboard you can order it to move or turn as a Magic action. It lasts 24 hours, then vanishes; you can dismiss it sooner with a Magic action.
